div.div:
Flows (1/2)
1 DNS lookup of events.<domain> (Route 53 answers with the NLB)
2 HTTPS request — TLS ends at the NLB with the ACM certificate
3 NLB → ingress-nginx NodePort (the NLB is built by Terraform, not by Kubernetes)
4 ingress routes by path: / → web · /api/auth · /api/events · /api/regis (+WebSocket) · /api/payment
5 /files/* is rewritten by the ingress straight to S3; only public/* is readable
6 event, registration, payment ask auth to validate the session cookie (get-session, cached in Redis 60 s)
7 auth, event, registration, payment → RDS (one database, one role, pool of 4 per pod)
8 same four → Redis (session cache, event cache, live-seat pub/sub)
9 auth (avatar) and event (cover, gallery, OG reads) write/read S3 with the session credentials
10 same four enqueue mail (template + props) on SQS

text.tspan: 1 DNS lookup of events.<domain> (Route 53 answers with the NLB)
2 HTTPS request — TLS ends at the NLB with the ACM certificate
3 NLB → ingress-nginx NodePort (the NLB is built by Terraform, not by Kubernetes)
5 /files/* is rewritten by the ingress straight to S3; only public/* is readable
6 event, registration, payment ask auth to validate the session cookie (get-session, cached in Redis 60 s)
7 auth, event, registration, payment → RDS (one database, one role, pool of 4 per pod)
8 same four → Redis (session cache, event cache, live-seat pub/sub)
9 auth (avatar) and event (cover, gallery, OG reads) write/read S3 with the session credentials
10 same four enqueue mail (template + props) on SQS

div.div:
Flows (2/2)
11 mail-worker long-polls, renders the React Email template, deletes; 5 failed receives → DLQ
12 mail-worker → Gmail SMTP (dry-run log when no App Password)
13 payment → Stripe (checkout, verify, refund)
14 Stripe → webhook, over the public site (needs the domain)
15 auth → Google (sign-in; enabled only when the site is https)
16 web asks event for the page's title / image (Open Graph head)
17 make up/down = terraform apply, state in S3 (permanent: ECR, S3, SQS, secrets, DNS · nightly: EKS, RDS, NLB); make secrets
18 push to main: build + push images (a), helm upgrade + kubectl + db-migrate (b), read secrets (c)
19 kubelet pulls images from ECR; EKS control plane manages the nodes
Colours
━ user request · ━ service call · ━ data store · ━ mail (SQS) · ━ external API
┅ deploy / control · ┅ DNS / certificate setup · ▭ orange dashed box = not live yet
